building.name: George R. Moscone Recreation Center
building.completed_conflict: Two buildings stand on this parcel — a recreation centre of 1924 and a branch library of the early 1950s — while the assessor's roll gives the whole parcel a single build year of 1900.

historical_record.description: A recreation centre opened here in 1924 on the ground of Lobos Square — the 1906 refugee camp that had become a city park — first as the Funston Recreation Center, later Funston Playground, and today the George R. Moscone Recreation Center. It is a contributing building to the California Register-eligible discontiguous Midcentury Recreation Historic District.
The Marina Branch Library, built in the early 1950s and designated San Francisco City Landmark No. 262.
